report.scope: Prices: Google Shopping SA, 1 collection day (14 Nov 2026 = baseline), 37 items, 9 retailers, 88 clean prices, 221 marketplace offers · Search: Google Trends SA weekly, Jun–8 Nov 2026

c1.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM analyst.retail_prices WHERE day='2026-11-14'),
b AS (SELECT item, min(price_zar) bm FROM p WHERE channel IN ('grocery chain','wholesale') GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.item || ' · ' || CASE WHEN p.retailer='Amazon.co.za' THEN 'Amazon' ELSE 'Takealot' END AS "Item · marketplace", round(100*p.price_zar/b.bm) AS "Index (cheapest store = 100)", p.price_zar AS "Marketplace (R)", b.bm AS "Cheapest store (R)", round(p.price_zar-b.bm,2) AS "Gap (R)"
FROM p JOIN b USING(item) WHERE p.retailer IN ('Amazon.co.za','Takealot') ORDER BY 2 DESC
c1.title: Marketplaces win on nappies, lose on everyday grocery staples
c1.subtitle: Marketplace price ÷ cheapest grocery-chain or wholesale price for the same item, 14 Nov 2026 (10 comparisons)

c5.sql: SELECT to_char(day,'Mon-DD') AS "Week", day, max(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='black friday') AS "Black Friday", max(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='takealot') AS "Takealot", max(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='shein') AS "Shein", max(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='temu') AS "Temu", max(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='amazon south africa') AS "Amazon South Africa" FROM analyst.search_interest WHERE term_group='marketplace: online shopping · 12 months' AND day >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
c5.title: Black Friday searches take off from mid-October; Shein closes on Takealot
c5.subtitle: Google Trends SA, weekly interest (0–100, relative within group), Jun–8 Nov 2026

c6.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month',day),'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", round(avg(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='takealot')::numeric,1) AS "Takealot", round(avg(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='amazon south africa')::numeric,1) AS "Amazon South Africa", round(avg(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='temu')::numeric,1) AS "Temu", round(avg(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='shein')::numeric,1) AS "Shein", round(avg(interest) FILTER (WHERE term='black friday')::numeric,1) AS "Black Friday", count(DISTINCT day) AS "Weeks" FROM analyst.search_interest WHERE term_group='marketplace: online shopping · 12 months' AND day >= '2026-06-01' AND day < '2026-12-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
c6.title: Shein +55% and Temu +30% since June; Amazon SA search flat-to-down
c6.subtitle: Monthly average of weekly Google Trends interest, Jun–Nov 2026 (Nov = 2 weeks only)

c7.sql: SELECT channel, retailer, count(DISTINCT day) days, count(DISTINCT item) items, count(*) rows_, min(day) first_day, max(day) last_day FROM analyst.retail_prices WHERE day >= '2026-11-01' AND day < '2026-12-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1, items DESC
c7.title: Marketplaces price 9 basket items each, behind Sixty60 and Shoprite
c7.subtitle: Basket items with a clean comparable price per retailer, 14 Nov 2026 (baseline day)

c8.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM analyst.retail_prices WHERE day='2026-11-14')
SELECT a.item AS "Item", a.price_zar AS "Amazon.co.za (R)", t.price_zar AS "Takealot (R)", round(t.price_zar-a.price_zar,2) AS "Takealot minus Amazon (R)", round(100*(t.price_zar-a.price_zar)/a.price_zar) AS "Gap %", (SELECT min(price_zar) FROM p x WHERE x.item=a.item) AS "Cheapest anywhere (R)", (SELECT string_agg(retailer,', ') FROM p x WHERE x.item=a.item AND x.price_zar=(SELECT min(price_zar) FROM p y WHERE y.item=a.item)) AS "Cheapest retailer"
FROM p a JOIN p t ON a.item=t.item AND t.retailer='Takealot' WHERE a.retailer='Amazon.co.za'
c8.title: Only 2 basket items are priced by both marketplaces
c8.subtitle: Clean comparable prices, 14 Nov 2026; Gap % = Takealot vs Amazon

c9.sql:
SELECT retailer AS "Marketplace", count(*) AS "Offers seen", count(DISTINCT item) AS "Basket items with any offer", count(DISTINCT item) FILTER (WHERE matches_item) AS "Items with matching offer", count(*) FILTER (WHERE matches_item) AS "Matching offers", round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE price_vs_item_median>=2 OR price_vs_item_median<0.5)/count(*)) AS "% offers off-size or multipack", count(DISTINCT seller) AS "Seller labels", round(avg(rating)::numeric,1) AS "Avg rating", count(rating) AS "Rated offers", round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reviews)::numeric) AS "Median reviews", round(avg(position)) AS "Avg search position"
FROM analyst.retail_offers WHERE retailer IN ('Amazon.co.za','Takealot') GROUP BY 1
c9.title: Takealot lists more, but 82% of its offers are off-size or multipacks
c9.subtitle: All Google Shopping offers for the basket, 14 Nov 2026

c10.sql: SELECT item || ' · ' || CASE WHEN retailer='Amazon.co.za' THEN 'Amazon' ELSE 'Takealot' END AS "Item · marketplace", count(*) AS "Matching offers", min(price_zar) AS "Lowest (R)", max(price_zar) AS "Highest (R)", round(100*(max(price_zar)-min(price_zar))/min(price_zar)) AS "Spread %" FROM analyst.retail_offers WHERE retailer IN ('Amazon.co.za','Takealot') AND matches_item GROUP BY item, retailer HAVING count(*)>1 ORDER BY "Spread %" DESC LIMIT 10
c10.title: Seller spreads of 71%–449% on the same listed item
c10.subtitle: Top 10: highest vs lowest matching marketplace offer, 14 Nov 2026

steps: Prices (sections 1, 2, 4): analyst.retail_prices for day = 2026-11-14, the only collection day in 1 Nov–1 Dec 2026; channel 'online marketplace' = Amazon.co.za and Takealot
Store benchmark (section 2): lowest grocery-chain or wholesale price for the same item on 14 Nov; index = 100 × marketplace price ÷ that price, over 5 items per marketplace
Assortment, ratings and sellers (section 5): analyst.retail_offers for 14 Nov (221 marketplace offers of 1,407): seller labels, matches_item, price_vs_item_median, rating, reviews, position
Within-month change (section 1): analyst.retail_price_changes — all 88 rows are 14 Nov with no previous day, so no change is reported

Search (sections 3 and 6): analyst.search_interest, term_group 'marketplace: online shopping · 12 months', weekly values 7 Jun–8 Nov 2026 (monthly averages Jun–Nov) plus weeks of 9 Nov–7 Dec 2025 from the same pull for the seasonal comparison
trust: Same-item, same-day comparisons with size-matched, outlier-filtered prices
Search trends come from one consistent Google Trends pull, compared only within its group
Every figure was queried directly; rand gaps and % are computed from the same rows
limits: Only one price day: no price momentum or promotion figures until December; no price data exists before 14 Nov 2026
Comparisons rest on very few items (2 shared marketplace items, 5 per marketplace vs stores) and some multipacks may pass the size filter
Search data ends 8 Nov 2026 and November averages cover 2 weeks; Trends values are relative, not search volumes
